text:
Ivy: hi team, new hire here. i'm able to ssh to the bastion but large docker pulls from our internal registry (10.52.9.8) keep hanging at ~8-10MB and then time out when i'm on split-tunnel VPN at home. small requests succeed. office network is fine. MacBook Air M1, WireGuard. anyone seen partial downloads like this?

Marco (Networking): welcome Ivy! that sounds like MTU/fragmentation or ICMP-blocking on the path. ISP or home router might be dropping ICMP "fragmentation needed" which prevents PMTU discovery and causes large TCP segments to stall. Can you run `curl -v --limit-rate 1M http://10.52.9.8/largefile` and `ping -s 1472 10.52.9.8` and paste outputs? also `ifconfig utun*` to see MTU.

Ivy: pasted snippets — short version:
```
$ ping -s 1472 10.52.9.8
PING 10.52.9.8 (10.52.9.8): 1472 data bytes
^C
--- 10.52.9.8 ping statistics ---
5 packets transmitted, 0 packets received, 100.0% packet loss
$ ifconfig utun2
utun2: flags=8051<UP,POINTOPOINT,RUNNING,MULTICAST> mtu 1380
  inet 10.210.3.7 --> 10.210.3.7 netmask 0xffffffff
```
curl hangs at the same place and never gets an ICMP message back.

Marco (Networking): yep that lines up. WireGuard often has lower MTU and if the home NAT/ISP blocks ICMP type 3 code 4 (fragmentation needed) you'll never shrink segments and large packets get dropped. Two quick workarounds: 1) lower the MTU on the WireGuard interface: `sudo ifconfig utun2 mtu 1200` (macOS) or in WireGuard config set `MTU = 1280`. 2) enable TCP MSS clamping on the gateway side (we can't change the ISP router, but you can enable MSS clamping locally with pf on mac: add `scrub` rules or on Linux `iptables -t mangle -A FORWARD -p tcp --tcp-flags SYN,RST SYN -j TCPMSS --clamp-mss-to-pmtu`). For an immediate temporary fix try MTU 1200.

Tess (Infra): adding that we also recommend `sysctl net.inet.tcp.mtu_probing=1` (mac) or `net.ipv4.tcp_mtu_probing=1` (linux) to help discover a working PMTU. But note sysctl changes can have side effects; prefer MTU change in the WireGuard config for onboarding.

Ivy: changed utun2 to mtu 1200 and reran the docker pull  it completed successfully! thank you. is it worth adding a note to onboarding docs for mtu issues?

Marco (Networking): yes please. i'll add a short FAQ entry "large downloads hang on split-tunnel -> lower VPN MTU or use SOCKS" with steps for mac/linux/windows and example commands. also note: some home routers have a buggy TCP MSS clamp implementation, so lowering MTU in client is safest for new hires.

Tess (Infra): i'll create a tiny script that checks large-transfer behavior by trying a curl of a 20MB artifact and if it stalls suggests MTU 1200 or enabling mtu_probing. we'll track this as a follow-up.

Infra Bot: Created ticket INF-834: "Onboarding: detect PMTU/MTU issues and recommend WireGuard MTU/TCP_MTU_PROBING" assigned to Networking.

Ivy: leaving this thread for others who hit similar flaky home setups. thanks again everyone :heart:
